verdict.rationale: Working Copy has a documented automation surface (an x-callback-url scheme), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. However, its own URL-scheme documentation is prose with inline iOS deep-link examples and explicitly states there is "no interactive reference." Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404, so nothing shows an explorable API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
